entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Patrick's Cathedral is a Roman Catholic religious building located adjacent to the 'Empress Garden' in Pune, India). Built in neo-gothic style in the middle of the 19th century, it was adopted as 'cathedral' church when Pune was made diocese (1886), of which it is still the main church. It also has the highest number of parishioners of the Pune diocese.
